projects.title: MediReport AI
projects.summary: Intelligent automated medical report generation and patient diagnostic summarization platform.
projects.problem: Healthcare clinics suffered from physician burnout due to 4+ hours of manual daily report drafting.
projects.solution: Built an automated medical summarizer that synthesizes lab markers into clear clinician drafts in under 15 seconds.
projects.outcome: Reduced clinical documentation time by 70% across beta test practices.

projects.title: Blissful Blinds Ltd
projects.summary: Custom online ordering and dynamic measurement quoting platform for a UK-based window furnishings manufacturer.
projects.problem: Customers struggled with non-standard window measurement pricing, creating high support inquiry drop-offs.
projects.solution: Engineered an interactive real-time dimensions calculator with instant quotation and secure Stripe checkout.
projects.outcome: Achieved 42% increase in completed online orders within the first 90 days.

projects.title: DevSync AI
projects.summary: Real-time automated code documentation, architecture sync, and pull request intelligence tool.
projects.problem: Engineering teams suffered from obsolete documentation as codebases rapidly evolved.
projects.solution: Automated pipeline that monitors Git commit diffs and updates markdown documentation dynamically.
projects.outcome: Over 1,200 developer repositories connected with zero drift in API specs.

projects.title: OFM Mobile App
projects.summary: Cross-platform mobile application providing on-demand logistics dispatch, driver routing, and delivery tracking.
projects.problem: Dispatchers needed low-latency driver tracking without expensive proprietary GPS tracking hardware.
projects.solution: Built a Flutter mobile app utilizing background GPS, real-time socket updates, and automated route optimization.
projects.outcome: Processed over 25,000 deliveries with 99.4% on-time dispatch accuracy.
